question: Should OpenClaw require deterministic migration for the 37 released bundled skills before removal, or intentionally accept a breaking upgrade that requires manual ClawHub recovery?
rationale: Source, release, and merge-result evidence prove that shipped capability is removed; choosing capability-preserving migration versus intentional manual recovery is product and upgrade policy, not a safe automated-review inference.

options.title: Require migration first
options.body: Add and prove an `openclaw doctor --fix` or equivalent migration for released references before deleting the bundle.

options.title: Own the breaking upgrade
options.body: Approve manual owner-qualified ClawHub reinstall and config updates as the supported path, with prominent release and in-product recovery guidance.

options.title: Split safe plugin work
options.body: Preserve the independently useful Sherpa and catalog changes in a narrower PR while deferring bundle removal.

recommendation.title: Require migration first
recommendation.body: Add and prove an `openclaw doctor --fix` or equivalent migration for released references before deleting the bundle.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest merged history and current assignment for both the skill ownership split and ClawHub upgrade behavior.
